units.text: A city that does not care.
Two stools at the far corner, away from the party.

units.name: JESS
paren: pulling her sleeves over her hands

units.name: THEO
paren: not looking at her, turning a glass

units.text: I said there was free food.
units.name: JESS
paren: laughs, too fast

units.name: THEO
paren: sets the glass down, slides it an inch away

units.name: JESS
paren: looks at the glass, then the skyline

units.text: This is the last summer they will be two people who share a hometown.

units.name: THEO
paren: finally meeting her eyes, then not

units.name: JESS
paren: picks at a label

units.name: THEO
paren: nods slowly, counts something on the bar with his finger

units.name: JESS
paren: quiet

units.name: THEO
paren: shrugs, a shrug with a lot of weight in it

units.text: I don't know. Anything. You used to say everything.
units.name: JESS
paren: a short breath

units.text: I used to think it would change something.
units.name: THEO
paren: pushes his stool back, an inch, two

units.name: JESS
paren: stands, stool scraping

units.text: Fair. You decided this in March. You told your mum before you told me.
units.name: THEO
paren: standing too, voice tight

units.text: Because I knew you'd do this. Go quiet. Make it my fault.
units.name: JESS
paren: hands shaking, grabs her jacket

units.name: THEO
paren: louder, a head turns at the next table

units.text: Then say it! Say you don't want me to go!
units.name: JESS
paren: throws the jacket down, not caring who looks

units.text: I don't want you to go.
units.name: THEO
paren: a long beat. He breathes. His whole face gives

units.name: JESS
paren: whispering, the fight draining out of her

units.name: THEO
paren: picks up the jacket, holds it out

units.name: JESS
paren: takes it. Doesn't put it on

units.name: THEO
paren: smiles, wet-eyed
